messages:
Maya: FYI opening a docs PR to align SDK examples and the migration guide with new compliance wording around audit logs + retention. Wanted a quick review before I mark ready.

Sam: thanks — can you paste the snippet you updated? I want to check the wording around PII handling.

Maya: sure, pasted below. kept it minimal and language-checked by legal:

```
# SDK: enable audit logging (pseudocode)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
response = client.generate(prompt)
# Audit events: request_id, model, hashed_user_id, minimal_metadata
client.audit.log(request_id=response.id, user_hash=hash(user.id))
```

Sam: looks good. Two small asks: 1) clarify that hashed_user_id is one-way and not reversible; 2) link to the retention policy section.

Maya: updated in PR: added note "one-way hash (SHA-256)" and a cross-link to /docs/compliance/data-retention. Also added an example migration note for teams that previously stored plain user ids.

Leo: quick infra note — our runtime emits audit events at INFO level by default. If docs suggest enabling extra logs, call out the cost/ingestion impact.

Maya: good catch. I added a short blurb: "Enabling verbose audit logs may increase log volume; consider sampling or routing to a dedicated log sink."

Harper: from security: add a sentence about key rotation impact on log correlation. If keys rotate, include stable request_id in events so you can correlate across rotations.

Maya: done. Inserted: "Use stable correlation ids (request_id) to stitch events across key rotations and model rollouts."

Ava: legal reviewed the SOC2 paragraph. Replace "we retain logs indefinitely" with the configurable retention ranges and default 90 days. Also please avoid implying we store raw PII in logs.

Maya: updated phrasing to: "Default audit log retention: 90 days (configurable by enterprise plan). Logs by default do not contain raw PII; where identifiers are required they should be one-way hashed."

Sam: can you add a tiny SDK test snippet showing how to redact before logging? e.g., simple phone/email scrub.

Maya: added:

```
def scrub_user(user):
    return {"user_hash": sha256(user.id), "email": "REDACTED"}

client.audit.log(request_id=resp.id, user_metadata=scrub_user(user))
```

docs-bot: CI for PR #3421 passed — preview site available at https://redwood-inference.dev/docs/pr-3421

Leo: the preview link looks fine, but the diagram in the migration guide is missing the log-forwarder box. I can drop a small SVG.

Maya: awesome, can you attach it to the PR? I'll squash the edits after you add it.

Harper: approved from sec side with the caveat that internal teams must follow the retention config process for enterprise customers.

Ava: legal signs off on final wording.

Sam: will do a lightweight editorial pass tomorrow morning and merge if no further comments.

Maya: thanks everyone! I'll wait for the SVG then merge and backport the SDK snippet to the 1.x branch.

Sam: note for backport — 1.x client uses `audit.log_event` not `audit.log`.

Maya: noted, added compatibility note in the migration guide.

Leo: uploaded SVG -> PR. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421/files#diff-...svg

Maya: merging in 30m unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
